visual.potential_relevance: A promised commission or credit is visibly connected to the requested action of obtaining or completing platform orders, which may merit review as a task-linked return claim.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether completing an order requires payment, whether the displayed amount is a cost or reward, or whether any commission is genuine or received.

visual.potential_relevance: The platform's displayed earning-related features are linked to requests for account, personal, and banking information, creating a task-relevant data-flow cue for review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the information was submitted, how it would be used, whether the bank details are required for withdrawal, or whether any funds moved.

visual.context: Presented as an in-app agent and referral promotion; the complete monthly amount and referral terms are not fully legible.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised earning opportunity is visibly associated with becoming an agent and inviting or referring other people through a code, QR code, or copied link.
visual.limitations: The samples do not establish whether invitations are required for payment, what recipients are asked to do, or whether anyone joined or received a reward.

visual.potential_relevance: A stated daily return is directly presented with a bank-linked withdrawal process and an apparent minimum-withdrawal condition, creating a return-and-funds-flow cue for review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish the applicable terms, whether the percentage is guaranteed, whether a fee or deposit is required, whether withdrawal succeeded, or whether any funds were transferred.

annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video promotes an earning app and presents app tasks as the route to earning money. The description explicitly lists playing games and completing tasks to earn money, and sampled screens show task orders. The bank-account request is a separate data-collection mechanism, so it is secondary rather than the central offer.
